name: high knee sprints
description: Running in place at full speed with your knees driving high. A quick way to raise your heart rate and warm up your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Start running in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your chest up.
Go hard for 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.
